Here, the 2nd number from the left end is the cube of the 1st number from the left end.

The 4th number from the left end is the cube of the 3rd number from the left end.

The 6th number from the left end is the cube of the 5th number from the left end.

The 8th number from the left end is the cube of the 7th number from the left end.

The 10th number from the left end is the cube of the 9th number from the left end.

The 12th number from the left end is the cube of the 11th number from the left end.

Thus, the cube of 7 is 343.

Here, the digits after the decimal is the reverse of the digits present before the decimal.

Also, the numbers start from 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Thus, the next term will start from 7.

32.23 + 11.11 = 43.34

43.34 + 11.11 = 54.45

54.45 + 11.11 = 65.56

65.56 + 11.11 = 76.67

The third number is thrice the difference of the first two numbers, So:

16-13= 3

The second number in each pair is 10 less than the square of the first number.

So,

172=289-10=279
